# EFTT { #deep_tensor.EFTT }

```python
EFTT(
    basis: Basis1D,
    tt: TT,
    options: EFTTOptions | None = None,
    device: torch.device = torch.get_default_device(),
)
```

An extended functional tensor train, defined on $[-1, 1]^{d}$.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**basis**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [Basis1D]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   The basis function used for each dimension of the FTT.

<code>[**tt**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [TT]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   A tensor train object.

<code>[**options**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [EFTTOptions \| None]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   A set of tuning parameters used during the construction of the  EFTT.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

<code>[**num_eval**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   The number of function evaluations required to construct the  EFTT.

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [approximate](#deep_tensor.EFTT.approximate) | Constructs a FTT approximation to a target function. |
| [eval](#deep_tensor.EFTT.eval) | Evaluates the FTT. |

### approximate { #deep_tensor.EFTT.approximate }

```python
EFTT.approximate(
    target_func: Callable[[Tensor], Tensor],
    dim: int,
    reference: Reference | None = None,
)
```

Constructs a FTT approximation to a target function.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**target_func**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [Callable\[\[Tensor\], Tensor\]]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   The target function, $f : [-1, 1]^{d} \rightarrow \mathbb{R}$.

<code>[**reference**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [Reference \| None]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   The reference measure. If provided, this will be used to  generate the samples to build the fibre matrix bases and  generate the initial index sets for the underlying TT.  Otherwise, the samples will be drawn uniformly.

### eval { #deep_tensor.EFTT.eval }

```python
EFTT.eval(ls: Tensor, direction: Direction | None = None)
```

Evaluates the FTT.

Returns the functional tensor train approximation to the target 
function for either the first or last $k$ variables, for a set 
of points mapped to the domain of the basis functions.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**ls**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [Tensor]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   An $n \times d$ matrix containing a set of samples mapped  to the domain of the FTT basis functions.

<code>[**direction**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [Direction \| None]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   The direction in which to iterate over the cores.

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[**Gs_prod**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [Tensor]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   An $n \times n_{k}$ matrix, where each row contains the  product of the first or last (depending on direction) $k$  tensor cores evaluated at the corresponding sample in `ls`.
